params.body:
## Reports
The next reports now run edge to edge under the feature, like the feature itself. There is a narrow gap between them, and no margin or heading around them. They used to sit in a padded frame under a band that ran to the edge. One line below the reports now reads "All reports and what comes next".

## Numbers
What grows is now shown as a lower bound: rounded down to two significant digits, with a plus.
- Signals: 230,517 becomes 230,000+.
- Active sources: 100+.
- Platforms: 16+.

The count of live trends stays exact, because a visitor can open and count those.

The caption was "Read from TikTok, Douyin and Bilibili ... Counted from the live graph, not from a deck." The second sentence read as defensive. Douyin and Bilibili are also off now (their past signals are still in the data). It now names kinds of sources and regions: "Social video, search, forums, news media, research and trend reports, read across Europe, the Americas and Asia."

## Why Gentells?
As a list on white, this section read flat. It now sits on the colour collage, under an even veil (`collage-band` gets `even`, so text on the right stays readable). Each comparison is a contrast:
- what others do, small and struck through;
- what we do, large, with one word in mint.

## The cover says who is behind it
FortiGuard (Fortinet) classes gentells.com as Phishing, and a company network blocked it on 1 October. The domain belonged to someone else in 2023 and 2024: an AutoSMTP bulk-mail server and a `/linkedin/` page (urlscan.io history). Trendwolves registered it in March 2026.

On top of that history, the cover showed one thing: an email field with no sender. It now shows:
- "© Trendwolves, Vlasgaardstraat 52, 9000 Ghent, Belgium";
- a link to the Terms and Conditions.

`/terms` is open behind the cover, so a filter or a visitor can read it. A test pins both.

## Contact
- The LinkedIn, X and Instagram buttons all pointed to `#`. They are removed until there are real accounts.
- The consent line linked "Privacy Policy" to `#`. It now points to section 13 of the Terms, the part about personal data, until a privacy policy exists.

Tests: 337 passing. Checked locally at 1440 px.
params.title: Home and cover: reports edge to edge, numbers as a floor, Why Gentells on the collage, a sender on the cover
